ma.onBluetoothDeviceFound(function listener)

Listen for events when new devices are found (minimum version: 24.6.0)

Parameter

function listener

Listening function for events when a new device is found

Parameter
object res
Attribute Type Description
devices Array List of newly discovered devices

Array devices

Object ArrayItem
Attribute Type Description
RSSI Number The signal strength of the current Bluetooth device, in dBm
advertisServiceUUIDs Array ServiceUUIDs data segment in the broadcast data segment of the current Bluetooth device
connectable Boolean Whether the current Bluetooth device can be connected (this value is not supported below Android 8.0)
deviceId String Bluetooth device id
localName String The LocalName data segment in the broadcast data segment of the current Bluetooth device
name String Bluetooth device name, some devices may not have it

Sample Code

ma.onBluetoothDeviceFound((res) => {
  ma.showModal({
    title: 'onBluetoothDeviceFound',
    content: JSON.stringify(res),
    showCancel: true
  })
})
